questions.prompt: Bengaluru produces thousands of tonnes of waste each day, much of it wet kitchen waste. Evaluate home composting as part of the solution.
questions.modelAnswer: Advantages: wet waste makes up a large share of household waste, and decomposers can turn it into compost that enriches soil for gardens and farms, reducing the waste sent to landfills (which cause smells, groundwater pollution and methane). It is cheap and teaches responsibility. Limitations: it needs space, time and correct care, otherwise bins smell and attract pests; flats may lack space; plastic and glass still need recycling. Overall it is a valuable part of the solution when combined with waste segregation and community composting.
questions.explain: Criterion D: evaluate a real solution.
